author: Matt Walsh
description:
Today on The Matt Walsh Show, airports across the country have become dysfunctional hellscapes with TSA wait times in excess of 3 hours in some cases. All of that is bad enough on its own. But it's even worse when you consider the reason: Democrats are once again making American citizens suffer for the sake of protecting foreign invaders. Also, a man in Seattle shot a pregnant woman at a traffic light, killing her and her baby. He’s just been found “not guilty by reason of insanity.” Is it time to abolish the insanity defense once and for all? And some good news out of Hollywood for a change as a wholesome family film, Project Hail Mary, becomes one of the most successful movies in recent years. I saw the film with my family over the weekend. I'll give you my review.
